overview.title: Safety alarms people can *trust.*
paragraphs: SafeGuard LPG continuously monitors gas level, smoke and temperature, and triggers an alarm that corresponds to the event it detects — so a gas leak, a fire risk and overheating are each clearly identified.

An alarm that sounds too often is easy to ignore. SafeGuard LPG uses an adaptive learning mechanism that learns the normal conditions of its environment, reducing false triggers over time while staying responsive to real hazards.

features.title: LPG leak detection
features.text: Continuous gas-level monitoring for liquefied petroleum gas.

features.title: Smoke detection
features.text: Early warning of smoke in the monitored space.

features.title: Temperature monitoring
features.text: Detects abnormal heat before it becomes dangerous.

features.title: Event-specific alarms
features.text: A distinct alarm for each type of hazard.

features.title: Adaptive learning
features.text: Fewer false triggers the longer it runs.

features.title: Built-in self-test
features.text: Checks its status LEDs, buzzer and sensors from the touchscreen.

steps.title: Sense
steps.text: Gas, smoke and temperature sensors are read continuously.

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: Readings are evaluated against what is normal for that environment.

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: A real hazard triggers the alarm that matches the event.

steps.title: Learn
steps.text: The system adapts over time, cutting false triggers.
